page: Amazon Web Services trn2u.48xlarge is a high-capacity instance type built on the Nitro hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel processor with 192 dedicated vCPUs, 96 physical cores, and a clock speed of 3.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 2048.0 GB of system memory, yielding 10.67 GB of RAM per core.

For local storage, the instance includes 7600 GB of NVMe SSD capacity, providing high-speed local read and write capabilities. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 200 Gbps, facilitating rapid data transfer across distributed environments. The instance does not include discrete GPUs in its hardware specification and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The resource profile of this instance offers high memory density and substantial local NVMe storage, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring massive memory footprints and high-throughput local storage without the need for GPU acceleration. Suitable workloads include large-scale databases, memory-intensive data processing, enterprise applications, and high-performance computing tasks.
